newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Body of missing British hiker found in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Body of missing British hiker found in Hong Kong.

text.p: The body of a British hiker missing since October has been found on a remote Hong Kong hillside next to an S.O.S. sign he had spelled out with stones.
Police said on Saturday the corpse of English teacher Keith Gibbs, 55, was partially decomposed and the cause of death could not be immediately determined.
They surmised Gibbs, who worked as a journalist in Scotland before moving to Hong Kong 10 years ago, may have fallen from a steep ridge. Heavy rain was reported around the time of his disappearance.

Gibbs was found partially submerged in a stream, clothed in shorts and a shirt on Friday. He had assembled his desperate S.O.S. message in white stones but failed to attract the attention of searchers who scoured the trails on Lantau island where he was last sighted.
